Ashe

Support Sleeper

Vision + Slow Support Ashe

How to play this build

Play safe and poke with Frost Shot (Q) using the permaslow; use Hawkshot for free river vision. Your signature play is the Enchanted Crystal Arrow from fog to start fights or catch someone far away.

Skill order

Max priority:

W Andanada → Q Disparo Certero → E Halcón

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
As a support you don't farm, so max Volley (W) for poke; Q second for the permaslow.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. Frost Queen's Claim Support item: AP and passive gold; active sends ghosts that slow and give vision.
  3. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).
  4. Boots of Mobility Boots with huge out-of-combat move speed; great for roaming.
  5. Randuin's Omen Health and armor; active AoE slow that also cuts attackers' attack speed.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
0/9/21 — Utility/Defense
Why this page
0/9/21 leans utility and some defense: you're a utility support, not an assassin.
